hooks.command:
input="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT:-}"; case "$input" in *'git commit'*|*'git push'*) cat <<'MSG'

🤖 vpnctl workflow reminder (see CLAUDE.md → "Workflow rules"):
  1. Did you spawn a review-agent on the diff? (Agent / general-purpose)
  2. Did you spawn a test-writer-agent for new public APIs? (with spec only, no impl)
  3. After push: `gh run watch <id> --exit-status` to verify CI.

If this commit is docs-only or a <5-line hotfix, ignore.
MSG
;; esac
